data.name: Prithvi
data.gender_notes: Prithvi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root pṛth, 'to be broad' — Pṛthvī, the earth. Its root is Sanskrit pṛth (पृथ्). Prithvi, the Vedic earth goddess. Prithvi is a Sanskrit name meaning “Earth; the earth goddess”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Prithvi expresses “Earth; the earth goddess”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit root pṛth, 'to be broad' — Pṛthvī, the earth.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Prithvi total 48, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
